<timestamp>Friday, Oct 16, 2026, 10:42 AM (UTC+1)</timestamp>
<user_query>
the relay keeps reconnecting in a loop, attempt 14 failed (1006), retrying in 0ms
</user_query>

Root cause: the backoff in src/relay/socket.ts reset to 0ms after every 1006 close because `attempt` was re-initialised inside onClose. Moved it to the connection scope and capped the backoff at 30s with jitter. Added test relay.reconnect.test.ts that reproduces 20 consecutive 1006 closes.
Committed as 4f2e9a1 "Keep relay backoff across reconnects".
